Assumptions stated: KV math uses the per-token figure as already covering all layers and K+V, so no extra factor; overhead added once regardless of GPU count; no headroom/reservation buffer added since policy sets none; hourly cap is inclusive of exactly $4.00 (no offer sits there anyway); tensor parallelism requires all GPUs of one offer, so usable memory is the full gpu_count x vram.
